## Summary

Describe the change and the decision or reliability gap it addresses.

## Validation

- [ ] Ruff check and format check pass
- [ ] Unit and integration tests pass
- [ ] Fixture pipeline passes when pipeline behavior changes
- [ ] Point-in-time controls remain valid
- [ ] Metrics and reports are generated, not manually invented
- [ ] No raw customer data, models, credentials, or secrets are added

## Business and model impact

Document changes to target definition, features, model selection, calibration, policy assumptions, campaign capacity, or monitoring thresholds. Link an ADR for material decisions.
